manifest_universe_definition: 2026-10-11 current Spot USDT active pairs, historical survivor biased; does not include historical delisted
date_selection: All calendar 17ths at 3-month intervals beginning November 2025 through August 2026; not selected from price, outcome, pumps, or known winners; compared with already completed September 17 2026 benchmark
source: Binance official daily 1m Spot archive ZIP and publisher CHECKSUM; 3 archive days per symbol per date
method: Unmodified production V4 D0 observe_snapshot / D1 process_queue, same 24h quote proxy, 3m 1m close poll, same filters, same per-side 10bps fee plus 20bps slippage hypothetical 24h exit
scope: 504 × 4 dates target, each 3,600 verified 1m history if listed; incomplete/censored kept as errors
research_risks: D0/D1 prices are closed 1m snapshot proxy not actual historical ticker stream
Current survivor-bias 504 scope may lack delisted historical winners
No fully novel out-of-sample because user research previously viewed some 2025-26 events
Study target false alert load, not sufficient to establish net profitability
